summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The FT Vest Nasdaq-100 Dual Directional Buffer ETF - June (DQJN) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in downside hedge alternatives. The investment objective of the FT Vest Nasdaq-100 Dual Directional Buffer ETF  June (the Fund) is to seek to provide investors with returns (before fees and expenses) that either match the positive price return of the Invesco QQQ TrustSM, Series 1. DQJN was launched on Jun 18, 2026 and is issued by First Trust.
